fusions.name: Both Nests Empty
fusions.desc: Sends rats and bees out in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Barbed Parting Gift
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that leaves a barb in the target: it deals 9 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Verminous Hive
fusions.desc: Calls a mixed swarm of rats and bees that fights for 12 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1 second, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: One Stings, All Bite
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
